recommendation_summary: Set up one external missed-run (dead-man) monitor that `nightly-sync` pings only after a successful run, and that emails the user if the ping doesn't arrive by the deadline.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging, Docker, and a Synology monitoring stack.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends email only if it reaches the reporting step. Nothing notices its silence.
labels.Checked myself: No independent checks; your account establishes four startup failures with no alert.

note: The reply recommends a single external heartbeat alert, explicitly drops the framed log/Docker stack, and gives a complete, grounded record before the recommendation.
